items.title: Microsoft and Goldman Sachs Opted Out of Tokenized Trading
points: Both firms had previously announced plans to participate in blockchain-based securities trading platforms (using blockchain to record and settle trades of traditional financial assets) but have now withdrawn their commitments

The pullback signals institutional investors are losing confidence in the timeline and viability of tokenized asset settlement (converting traditional securities into blockchain-based digital tokens that can be traded and settled faster)
Regulatory uncertainty around how financial regulators will treat on-chain trading and custody remains a major barrier to institutional participation
Despite years of development, tokenized securities infrastructure still lacks the institutional trust and regulatory clarity needed for mainstream adoption
Other financial institutions may reassess their blockchain initiatives following high-profile withdrawals from major players like Microsoft and Goldman Sachs

items.title: BlackRock IBIT Inflows and Spot ETF Market Activity
points: BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin ETF drew $665.16M on Monday, marking its biggest single day since October 7, 2025
US spot Bitcoin ETFs netted $526.6M total despite outflows from Fidelity and Grayscale funds, showing mixed investor sentiment
Spot ether ETFs lost $103.3M and posted their fourth consecutive day of outflows

Bitcoin remains range-bound between $82,000-$83,000 amid concerns about potential rate hikes; one analyst suggested investors may be positioning for a 'catch-up trade' with unclear fundamental drivers
BlackRock filed for an iShares Bitcoin Managed Protect ETF offering downside protection plus upside exposure

items.title: Quantum-Safe Privacy Pools and Cryptographic Innovation
points: A new ethresear.ch proposal ports Tornado Cash-style privacy pools to Flock, a transparent hash-based SNARK (a zero-knowledge proof system that compresses cryptographic computation into a compact proof for verification) using SHA-256 instead of traditional discrete-log assumptions
Prover time drops 28x - from 810 milliseconds to 28.6 milliseconds at depth 32 - through a stepwise SHA-256 circuit with sumcheck aggregation, producing a 266 kilobyte proof
An aggregation layer lets users prove individual withdrawals in ~19.5ms each, then folds multiple proofs into a single ~344 kilobyte proof that verifies in 46-64 milliseconds regardless of batch size

The scheme includes a quantum recovery protocol: if a cryptographically relevant quantum computer is announced, the pool freezes, and users withdraw through a post-quantum verifier seeded from their original 256-bit key while maintaining nullifier (transaction linkage prevention) tracking

items.title: Corporate Bitcoin Holdings and Treasury Strategy
points: Strive acquired 4,045 BTC for $335 million (average $82,803/BTC) between October 12-16, bringing total holdings to 36,818 BTC (~$3 billion), ranking fourth among publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holders and surpassing MARA Holdings
Share count grew 12.4% while BTC holdings rose 12.3%, leaving Bitcoin per share roughly flat - a sign of dilution
Strive priced a $630 million SATS preferred stock offering with a 15% annual dividend, distributions beginning November 9
Arkham Intelligence tracked ~$82 million in BTC transferred from MARA-linked wallets to Binance and Gate, signaling potential distributions from the firm Strive just surpassed

items.title: Custody, Insurance, and Regulated Infrastructure
points: AnchorWatch Trust Company launched as a Nevada-chartered qualified Bitcoin custodian targeting fiduciaries, public companies, trusts, and high-net-worth individuals
Two custody models available: Flagship (AnchorWatch holds qualifying keys, clients retain additional control) and Distributed (keys split across AnchorWatch, BitGo, and CoinCorner)
Fixed monthly fees capped at $10,000 regardless of portfolio size decouple custodian revenue from Bitcoin price, eliminating conflicts of interest
Optional insurance through A+ rated Lloyd's of London syndicates covers up to $370 million per client against losses from violent coercion, kidnapping, and AnchorWatch-caused fraud

points: Mesh partnered with Visa to let users spend crypto and stablecoin balances directly at 175+ million merchant locations without manually converting or transferring assets
Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade is scheduled for October 26 on the Hoodi testnet
